ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels to 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white segments occupy the center of both lobes. Black pigmentation is concentrated at the peduncle-fluke junction (forming a wide V-shape) and extends as an irregular mottled border along the entire trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 40-45 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes (peaks and valleys) visible across the entire trailing edge boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct convex sweep on the lateral margins of the lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent, high-relief clusters of high-intensity white/beige circular nodes localized at the distal tips of both fluke lobes, indicative of dense barnacle colonies.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple dark, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (scratches) within the white interior region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle encrustations at the distal lobe tips; presence of faint circular scarring/depigmentation patterns on the dark central pigmentation near the median notch.
